lines.text: In 1956, ten men spent a summer inventing a name for it.
For forty years it mostly lost. Then it beat Kasparov.
In 2012 it learned to see, and nobody outside the labs noticed.
In 2016 it played a move no human would have played.
Then it learned to talk, and a hundred million people arrived.
Seventy years to arrive. Two months to be everywhere.
